sections.title: Why SOS Moving Fits Echo Park
sections.content: Echo Park was laid out before cars ruled Los Angeles, and it shows: many homes are reached only by public stairways, and some streets are steep enough to strand a long truck. We plan where the truck can safely stop, then carry the rest by hand at the same hourly rate. What you can count on: Licensed carrier: CPUC licensed under CAL-T0192140, with USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871, full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Top-rated service: Customers rate us 4.9 on Google across 1,007 reviews. No stair surcharge: Stairs, long carries from the curb and extra stops are all covered by the hourly rate. Tell us your street and whether your door sits up a stairway, and we will size the crew and the plan to match. Request a free estimate or call 909-443-0004.

sections.title: Packing Help for Echo Park Stairways and Victorians
sections.content: When every carton travels down a flight of public steps, the way it is packed matters as much as the way it is carried. Our packing services keep boxes compact, sealed and manageable on narrow stairs. How we pack for Echo Park: Carroll Avenue Victorians: For the Queen Anne-Eastlake homes of Angelino Heights, add white glove handling for antiques, mirrors and heirloom furniture. Wardrobe boxes: Hanging clothes go straight into wardrobe boxes that come with the move, so closets empty without piles of loose garments. Wrap and tape: Moving blankets, shrink wrap and packing tape are part of the hourly rate, not a separate materials bill. Want the whole house packed, or just the kitchen and the art? See our packing options.

sections.title: Local Movers Echo Park Can Count On
sections.content: Whether you are leaving a place near Echo Park Lake for Silver Lake or heading out of state with our long-distance movers, the plan starts with Echo Park's hills and game-day traffic. What we plan around in Echo Park: Stair-only homes: Where a house is reached only by a public stairway, our movers hand-carry each piece between the truck and your door at no extra charge. Steep grades: We keep the truck off crests like Baxter Street, one of the steepest streets in Los Angeles, where long vehicles have been known to get stuck at the top. Dodgers home games: Game-day traffic headed for Dodger Stadium can gridlock Echo Park streets, so we help you pick a start time and truck spot that avoid the rush. Moving a few neighborhoods over? See how our hourly moving service works, or get a free estimate for your date.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves From Echo Park
sections.content: Leaving the lotus beds of Echo Park Lake behind for a new state? Our long-distance movers pack, load and drive your household there, while our local moving crews handle it if you are staying in Los Angeles. Routes we plan from Echo Park: Up the coast: The Bay Area, Portland and Seattle, for moves that follow work or family north along the West Coast. Desert and Rockies: Phoenix, Las Vegas, Denver and Salt Lake City, for anyone swapping Echo Park's hills for the desert or the mountains. Cross-country: Austin, Chicago, New York and beyond, with storage available if your new place is not ready when the truck arrives. Send us your destination and moving window, and we will build a long-distance estimate around it. Request yours here.

sections.title: Office and Storefront Moves in Echo Park
sections.content: Offices and shops along Sunset and Glendale boulevards, Echo Park's main commercial corridors, can schedule commercial moving on a Monday–Thursday or a Friday–Sunday to work around business hours.

faq.question: Can you move furniture to an Echo Park home that sits on a public stairway?
faq.answer: Yes. Many Echo Park houses are reached only by public stairways, so we park as close as the street allows and carry everything by hand. Stairs and long carries are included in the hourly rate. Items heavier than 300 lbs add $150, and a piano is $200.

faq.question: How do Dodgers home games affect a move in Echo Park?
faq.answer: Traffic heading to Dodger Stadium can gridlock Echo Park streets on game days, and some blocks near the ballpark are signed for permit-only parking during events. Give us your address and date when you book, and we will plan the start time and truck parking around the game schedule.

faq.question: Can your truck get up Baxter Street and other steep Echo Park streets?
faq.answer: Baxter Street is one of the steepest streets in Los Angeles, parts of it were converted to one-way traffic, and long vehicles have gotten stuck at the top. We plan an approach that keeps the truck off crests like that and walk the load in from a safer spot. That carry time is billed at the normal hourly rate with no extra charge.

faq.question: What does a stair-street move in Echo Park run per hour?
faq.answer: Monday–Thursday, 2 movers and a truck start at $119/hr at the cash rate, and Friday–Sunday are $135/hr. There is a $30 gas fee and a $50 deposit that is applied toward your total. Stairs, long carries, moving blankets, shrink wrap and furniture disassembly are all included.
